item.title: Thousands of flights canceled as major winter storm moves across the US
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY (AP) — Thousands of flights across the U.S. set to take off over the weekend were canceled as a monster storm started to wreak havoc Saturday across much of the country, knocking out power and snarling major roadways with dangerous ice. item.title: Indianapolis police help evacuate business building engulfed in flames
item.description: Indianapolis firefighters battled a large blaze at a building with a body shop, a tire shop, and an auto dealership on Friday night. Indianapolis police helped to evacuate workers, four of whom were treated for smoke inhalation.

item.title: AES Indiana suspends disconnections amid winter storm
item.description: AES Indiana has temporarily suspended disconnections for nonpayment through the end of January in preparation for Winter Storm Fern, which is expected to bring significant snowfall and dangerously cold temperatures.

item.title: Winter storm peaks Sunday then dangerous cold lingers | Jan. 24, 2026
item.description: Central Indiana is expecting a prolonged arctic pattern with nighttime lows near zero much of the week, occasional wind gusts strong enough to drive wind chills back into the 10 to 20 below range early week, and daytime highs mainly in the teens and 20s.
